wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PG06 | prevtitle=The Reawakening | nextcode=PG08 | nexttitle=The Cavern | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=PG07 | colorscheme=Hoso| title_en=The Vision | title_ja=ビジョン | title_ja_trans=The Vision | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=December 16, 2016 | broadcast_us=October 14, 2016 | en_op=N/A | ja_op=N/A | ja_ed=N/A | olmteam=Team Kato | scenario=冨岡淳広 | storyboard=平川哲生 | director=平川哲生 | art=吉岡毅 | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=PG01-PG10 | footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wU-TWKxDu2o The Vision]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|219150|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The Vision''' (Japanese: '''ビジョン''' ''The Vision'') is the seventh episode of [[Pokémon Generations]]. It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on October 14, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 16, 2016. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== When an uninvited guest breaks into their headquarters, Team Magma must race against time to make their ambitions become a reality. ==Plot== In the [[Team Magma Hideout]], the alarms sound as an intruder enters the building. One of the steel doors inside the hideout is sliced open by a {{p|Sceptile}}'s {{m|Leaf Blade}} and the intruder is revealed to be {{ga|Brendan}}. Brendan and Sceptile proceed through the various sectors of the hideout and defeat [[Team Magma]]'s Pokémon along the way. His progress is followed through security footage by [[Tabitha]], who informs his boss [[Maxie]] about this. Maxie, Tabitha, and a group of {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}s head towards the [[Submarine Explorer 1]], which they stole and upgraded. They plan to use it to get through the [[Seafloor Cavern]] so they can awaken {{p|Groudon}}. Before entering the submarine, Maxie encounters [[Courtney]]. Maxie proclaims that Team Magma is leaving for the Seafloor Cavern and Tabitha instructs the Grunts to get inside the submarine. As Courtney proceeds to enter the submarine as well, Maxie interrupts her. He tells her that he wants her to stay at the hideout to stop the intruder, who is proceeding further into the hideout by the minute. Courtney says that she understands and watches as Maxie enters the submarine. Courtney tells Maxie that she looks forward to their plans becoming a reality to which Maxie replies they will meet each other again once the mission is over. As the submarine starts its engines, Courtney has a vision of the future. She sees [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] Groudon coming out of Seafloor Cavern, charging up a {{m|Solar Beam}}, and firing it to cause massive destruction in {{rt|128|Hoenn|the nearby area}}. Groudon begins to face towards Maxie, Tabitha, and the Team Magma Grunts and fires another Solar Beam at them. This ominous vision shocks Courtney, but as she starts to think about what this vision could mean, Brendan and Sceptile show up. Courtney tells Brendan that he is too late and that she will stop him. While doing so, the Submarine Explorer 1 dives underwater. Courtney sends out her {{p|Camerupt}} for {{pkmn|battle}} and laughs as she proclaims she wants to analyze Brendan. ==Major events== * {{ga|Brendan}} breaks into [[Team Magma]]'s [[Team Magma Hideout|Hideout]]. * [[Maxie]] and [[Tabitha]] head to the [[Seafloor Cavern]] aboard the modified [[Submarine Explorer 1]]. * [[Courtney]] stays behind in order to {{pkmn|battle}} and stall Brendan. * Courtney has a vision of [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] {{p|Groudon}} attacking Maxie. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{ga|Brendan}} * [[Maxie]] * [[Tabitha]] * [[Courtney]] * {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Sceptile}} ({{ga|Brendan}}'s) * {{p|Camerupt}} ([[Courtney]]'s) * {{p|Golbat}} ({{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}'s) * {{p|Mightyena}} ({{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}'s) * {{p|Groudon}} ([[Primal Reversion|Primal Groudon]];
